why: ChatGPT treated this as a pick-one-unit question: every recommendation (EG4 6000XP, 12000XP, FlexBOSS21, Sol-Ark 15K) is a single box, and it even ruled out Victron because the MultiPlus-II needs a separate MPPT, so 'all-in-one' means no second item is required. The facts that matter (48 V battery bus, 120/240 V split phase, grid export, PV input) decide which single model to recommend, so a comparison page that picks one fits better than a set. Sun Gold Power's store could hold an inverter with batteries and breakers, but the shopper did not ask for that.
